fields.label: Callback Security
fields.description: Protects the public URLs Safaricom posts results to. Turn enforcement on in this order: IP allow-list first, then the token for STK/B2C/status/balance results (sent with every request), and only after re-registering the C2B URLs, the token for C2B.

fields.label: Callback Token
fields.description: Random secret appended to every callback URL as ?t=… Generated automatically; use Regenerate Callback Token to rotate (then re-register C2B URLs).

fields.label: Require Token on STK / B2C / Status / Balance / Pull Callbacks
Require Token on C2B Validation / Confirmation
fields.description: Only enable after re-registering C2B URLs from each Mpesa C2B Payment Register URL record, otherwise every customer payment will be rejected.

fields.label: Only Accept Callbacks From Allowed IPs
Allowed Callback IPs / CIDRs
fields.description: One IP or CIDR per line. Defaults cover Safaricom's published Daraja callback addresses; confirm against your go-live pack.

fields.label: Integration User
fields.description: User that callbacks and background jobs run as. Leave empty to use Administrator (see If No Integration User). A dedicated System User with only Accounts and M-Pesa roles is recommended.

fields.label: If No Integration User
fields.description: Warn: callbacks run as Administrator and an Error Log is written once an hour. Refuse: callbacks are rejected until an Integration User is set. Use Refuse in production.

fields.label: Verify C2B Confirmations with Transaction Status
fields.description: Hold each C2B confirmation until a Transaction Status query confirms its receipt, amount and shortcode; only then create the register. Applies to shortcodes whose Mpesa Settings has an Initiator and Security Credential (the initiator must be allowed to query Transaction Status); confirmations for a shortcode without them are registered as they arrive, as before, with a daily Error Log reminder. Unconfirmed confirmations stay as Integration Requests (service 'Mpesa C2B Verification').

fields.label: Verify STK Callbacks with STK Query
fields.description: Confirm each STK callback with an STK Query (and the paid amount against the prompt) before the prompt is marked Completed and booked.

fields.label: Amount Match Tolerance (KES)
fields.description: Difference allowed when matching a receipt to an order or invoice amount.

fields.label: Hold New Supplier M-Pesa Accounts (Hours)
fields.description: A newly approved paybill / till can be paid only after this many hours, so a wrong or fraudulent number can be caught first. 0 = usable at once.

fields.label: Hold New Employee M-Pesa Accounts (Hours)
fields.description: A newly approved employee phone or bank paybill account can be paid only after this many hours. 0 = usable at once.

fields.label: Allow B2B to Numbers Not Saved on a Supplier
fields.description: Off: every B2B payment goes to an approved Supplier M-Pesa Account. On: M-Pesa / Accounts Managers may type a one-off paybill or till.

fields.label: Notify Role
fields.description: Role that receives M-Pesa alerts (unmatched money, failed payouts, balance drift).

fields.options: Each switch replaces one of Astral's Server Scripts. Turn a switch on only after disabling the script it replaces, so the work is not done twice.

fields.label: Create Bank Transaction for Every Receipt and Payout
fields.description: C2B and STK receipts, and Paid B2C / B2B payouts with their Safaricom charges, become submitted Bank Transactions on the shortcode's Bank Account (replaces 'Register To Bank Transaction', 'Auto Reconcile' pass 0, 'BT Duplicate Guard', 'Duplicate BT Sweeper', 'B2C Payout To Bank' and the charge pass of 'B2C Voucher Complete'). See the Money Out tab.

fields.label: Block Duplicate Receipts on M-Pesa Bank Accounts
Set Clearance Date When Every Bank Leg Is Matched
fields.description: Replaces 'AIL BT Sync Voucher Clearance'.

fields.label: Auto-Reconcile M-Pesa Bank Transactions
fields.description: Links each receipt line to its Payment Entry, each payout line to its Payment Entry (salary: Journal Entry) and each charge line to its charge Journal Entry, when amounts agree (replaces 'Auto Reconcile' passes 1–2 and 'B2C Voucher Complete').

fields.label: Use M-Pesa Receipt as Payment Entry Reference No
fields.description: Replaces 'PE Reference To Receipt'.

fields.label: Block a Second Payment Entry for the Same Receipt
fields.description: Replaces 'PE Duplicate Receipt Guard' (without its script-ordering race).

fields.label: Fill Missing Cost Center on M-Pesa Payment Entries
fields.description: Replaces 'PE Cost Center Autofill'.

fields.label: Clear Clearance Date on Amended PE / JE
fields.description: Replaces 'PE/JE Amendment Clear Clearance'.

fields.label: Match and Book Receipts Automatically
fields.description: Runs every 2 minutes on draft receipts with no customer or no booking.

fields.label: Repair Mistyped Invoice Numbers
fields.description: SINV2600123 → SINV26-00123 (replaces 'Self Heal Unmatched').

fields.label: Match Account Reference to a Customer Name
fields.description: Spaces and case ignored, exactly one customer (replaces 'C2B No-Space Name Matcher').

fields.label: Match Payer Phone to One Open Sales Order
fields.description: Uses Safaricom's hashed MSISDN and the order amount (replaces 'Payer Phone Matcher').

fields.label: Adopt Receipts From Unanswered STK Prompts
fields.description: Same amount, paid within the window after the prompt (replaces 'SO Checker' pass 0).

fields.label: Link Receipts Already Booked by Hand
fields.description: Replaces 'Register Link Backfill'.

fields.label: Book Receipts Against Sales Orders and Release Paid Orders
fields.description: Adds up every receipt for an order (STK prompts and direct paybill payments). When fully paid the order is moved through the workflow and the receipts are booked as advances (replaces 'SO M-Pesa Payment Checker').

fields.label: Approve Paid Orders As
fields.description: Workflow actions run as this user, so Workflow role rules still apply. Required when the order has a workflow.

fields.label: Workflow Actions for Paid Orders
fields.default:
Send For Approval Primary
Send for Approval Secondary
Approve
fields.description: One per line, applied in order while available. Leave empty to submit orders without a workflow.

fields.label: Write Receipt Details To Field
fields.description: Optional Small Text field on Sales Order that collects receipt lines.

fields.label: Normalise Phone on M-Pesa Payment Requests
fields.description: Replaces 'Normalize Mpesa Phone on Payment Request'.

fields.label: Cancel Earlier Unpaid Prompt When Re-prompting
fields.description: Properly cancels the older Payment Request instead of flipping docstatus (replaces 'MPesa PR Cleanup Before Reprompt').

fields.label: Poll Safaricom for Unanswered STK Prompts
fields.description: Asks Safaricom for the result of prompts with no callback after 2 minutes; marks cancelled/failed prompts.

fields.label: Mark Payment Requests Paid When Settled
fields.description: Replaces 'Status Sync'.

fields.options: Payout lines follow the Money In switch 'Create Bank Transaction for Every Receipt and Payout': each Paid B2C or B2B payout gets a withdrawal line (its receipt) within seconds of its result. The two switches below add the Safaricom charge (line CHG-<receipt> and a Journal Entry from the shortcode's M-Pesa Charges Account, Mpesa Settings → Accounting Mapping) and reconcile the lines with their entries. Both act only when the answer is certain; anything else is listed in Mpesa Match Log for you. Lines and entries Astral's feed scripts made are found by the same keys and never made twice; still disable 'AIL Mpesa Feed - B2C Payout To Bank' and 'B2C Voucher Complete' when you switch this on.

fields.label: Book Safaricom Charges Automatically
fields.description: Each Paid payout's Safaricom charge gets its own line (CHG-<receipt>) and a Journal Entry from the shortcode's M-Pesa Charges Account, only when the charge is certain: a B2B result states it; a B2C charge is its band below, and is left for you (listed in Mpesa Match Log) when the wallet balance on the result shows a different charge.

fields.label: Reconcile Payout and Charge Lines Automatically
fields.description: Needs 'Auto-Reconcile M-Pesa Bank Transactions' (Money In). A withdrawal line on an M-Pesa Bank Account is matched only with the one submitted entry that carries its receipt (Payment Entry Reference No; salary and charge Journal Entry Cheque No), pays out of that account and has exactly its amount. Anything else (no entry, another amount, two candidates) is left for you and listed in Mpesa Match Log.

fields.label: B2C Charge Bands
fields.description: Safaricom's B2C charge per payout, one band per line: '<payout up to KES> = <charge>'. The default is the tariff on Astral's 4139683 statements (Aug–Oct 2026): every charge row matches it, and the 23 payouts of KES 100 or less carried no charge. B2C results carry no charge, so the band is booked once the wallet balance on the result agrees or cannot tell; when it shows a different charge nothing is booked and Mpesa Match Log says why. Leave empty to book only the charge the balances show.

fields.label: Payout Lines From
fields.description: Payouts completed before this date get no lines or charge entries from the sweep (set to the upgrade date, so going live books nothing into past periods). Clear it, or move it back, to fill older payouts within Look Back (Days).

fields.options: Each shortcode is several wallets (Utility, Working / MMF, Merchant...). Map any of them to a Bank Account of its own on Mpesa Settings → Accounting Mapping → Sub-Accounts; nothing changes until you do. Import each wallet's statement from the M-PESA Org Portal (M-Pesa Statement Import) to bring in funding, transfers between wallets and sweeps to the bank, which Safaricom sends no callback for.

fields.label: Submit Transfer and Funding Entries
fields.description: The Internal Transfer Payment Entries a statement import books (between two wallets, or between a wallet and a bank) are submitted and reconciled. Untick to leave them as drafts for review.

fields.label: Match Bank Lines Within (Days)
fields.description: Funding from a bank, or a withdrawal to one, is matched with the bank's own line of exactly that amount from this many days before to one day after; only when there is exactly one.

fields.label: Ask Safaricom for Balances Every (Minutes)
fields.description: 0: never (balances are still recorded whenever someone presses Get Account Balance). Needs an Initiator with the Balance Query role on Mpesa Settings. Each balance is checked against the last imported statement plus the lines since; a difference is listed as a Gap in M-Pesa Balance Snapshot.

fields.label: Remind When a Paid B2B Has No Entry After (Days)
fields.description: A Paid B2B payment whose accounting entry is still not made (or not submitted, or needs checking) after this many days alerts the Notify Role once. 0 = never. Failed automatic bookings are tried again every 15 minutes for 30 days either way.

fields.label: Who Sends a Payout Must Not Be Who Prepared It
fields.description: On: Pay Selected refuses a scheduled line the payer prepared or last changed (amount, payee, document or Pay On), and submitting a B2B request, a B2C Payment Disbursement or a B2C request refuses whoever created it, last saved it or changes it while sending. Two people see every payout. Turn off only when one person does both jobs.

fields.label: Seconds Between Scheduled Payments
fields.description: After Confirm, the payments are sent to M-Pesa one at a time, this many seconds apart.
